title: Existing fixed-scalar pro-etale compact-support finiteness and amplitude
statement: Let k be any field, Lambda a finite commutative ring with invertible exponent over k, and f:X->Y a morphism between finite-type k-schemes with a compactification and compatible structure maps. The fixed-scalar pro-etale Rf_! preserves bounded constructibility of etale origin. If every geometric fibre of f has dimension at most e, it sends constructibleIn [a,b] into constructibleIn [a,b+2e], for all integers a,b, including empty intervals.

proof.text: Choose a bounded constructible etale origin. The compact-support site comparison transports etale bounded constructibility; the exact comparison pullback preserves cohomology. For the upper bound, reflect the input interval to its etale origin and apply finite-type sheaf compact-support vanishing and finite truncation induction. Exact open extension and left t-exact right derived direct image give the lower bound. Transport the resulting interval back by the normalized comparison. These are the already written proofs in the source Finiteness module.

theorem constructibleIn_rightDerivedLowerShriek [HasInvertibleExponent Λ (Spec (.of k))]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [HasCompactification f] (aX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType aX] [QuasiCompact aX]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY] (hf : f ≫ aY = aX) (e : ℕ)
    (he : ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y),
      topologicalKrullDim (Limits.pullback f s : Scheme.{u}) ≤ (e : WithBot ℕ∞)) (a b : ℤ)
    (K : _root_.DerivedCategory (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)))
    (hK : DerivedCategory.constructibleIn (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) X a b K) :
    DerivedCategory.constructibleIn (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) Y a (b + 2 * e)
      ((ProEtale.rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).obj K)
